verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management product, so a trigger-and-action rule builder is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents one. Reusable templates and scheduled check-in questions are adjacent features, not user-defined trigger/action rules. The REST API, OAuth and MCP support are developer building blocks that could be used to construct automation, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps
